name: Fluid container
description: An edge-to-edge container: no side margins, no cap in code today. For carousels, sliders and anything that should bleed to the viewport edge while still establishing a grid context for its children. Both of Will's layout notes say fluid should stop at 2560; neither stylesheet implements that, so the rule below is recorded as failing rather than quietly dropped.

breakpointBehavior.behavior: Edge to edge. Should stop at 2560 per the design notes; does not today.

classes.name: container-fluid
classes.purpose: Edge-to-edge container; overrides the percentage rule to 100%.

customProperties.name: --s2a-grid-container-width
customProperties.purpose: Overridden locally to 100% so nested rows do not inherit the 83.4% rule.

rules.statement: The fluid container is 100% wide with no cap below HD.
It resets the percentage rule to 100% locally, so a nested row does not inherit an 83.4% width it did not ask for.
The fluid container stops growing at 2560px. Beyond that the layout is no longer a layout, it is a stretched one.

decisions.question: Does the fluid container cap at 2560, as both Figma notes state, or stay genuinely uncapped?
decisions.evidence: Figma: 'Fluid: edge to edge margins but with a 2560 max' (08/26 V4) and 'Fluid: No max content container. (wip) maybe carousel or sliders etc. 2560 max' (04/23). Neither packages/grid nor Will's hosted demo implements a cap. The FLUID_CAP_2560 rule fails until one of the two changes.
